# TradePro Signals

TradePro Signals is a live crypto market analysis platform. It computes trade setups
(entry, stop loss, three take-profit targets, signal strength) from real Binance
public market data using EMA, RSI, MACD and ATR, refreshed continuously.

## What it is
- A live analysis and education tool for traders who execute on their own broker
  account (for example Exness / MetaTrader).
- Includes a position-size calculator (1% risk rule) and a step-by-step usage guide.

## What it is not
- Not a broker: it never accepts deposits and never holds client funds.
- Not financial advice, and it does not promise profits. In an out-of-sample
  backtest on real Binance data (24 configurations), the best first-target hit
  rate was 60.5% with expectancy close to break-even after estimated costs.
  No indicator strategy wins 90% of the time or always profits.

## Pricing (owner's plans)
- Premium: $29/month. Pro: $49/month. White-label licence available from the owner.
